notes: This is a preliminary process-only analysis. Persistent-mode results are outside this report.
The raw 64-row denominators retain the complete HTTP 503 for q-000078. Its backend timing fields are unavailable; stored zero placeholders do not measure zero startup or ask time.
Paired-success sensitivity excludes q-000078 in all four variants. This conditional comparison cannot measure reliability or remove the cold-start failure.
Conflict sensitivity excludes only q-000483 and q-000484. The raw sample keeps both annotations.
The sample contains all 24 baseline barcode hits. This selection oversamples the corpus hit fraction of 24/2228. Pilot fractions are not corpus estimates.
Each process request starts a new child. After-first does not establish warm remote models. A later rerank request can load a cold model.

HTTP wall includes upload, child startup, backend construction, ask, child cleanup, steps_answer, and the complete response read. Browser rendering, remote client LAN, client source-file read, client JSON parse, and service setup are outside this metric.
Build is inside startup. Ask and stages are inside process. Fresh barcode SAM3 is inside barcode. These nested timings MUST NOT be added.
Fresh crop responses are not reused by later package segmentation. The duplicated SAM3 cost is charged.
The four variants ran in fixed sequential order once. Paired differences are observations, not isolated causal estimates.
The experimental worker has different imports from unmodified recognize.py. Production files were not changed. No hard 3-second timeout is implemented or demonstrated.
Negative labels constrain forbidden wines. Zero forbidden predictions does not prove correct negative identification.
